subject: Request: Compensation and Trial Extension after Production Surge Outage
messages:
From: Tom Hayes <tom@velocity.ai>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Desai <priya.desai@velocity.ai>
Date: 2027-04-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Production errors during launch window — request for compensation and trial extension

Hannah,

We had a bad window this morning. Between 05:45-08:10 PT our integration with Redwood returned 5xx errors and high tail latency during our campaign launch. Our ingesters are retrying and the burst caused request queues to pile up; we lost ~2.4M inference tokens and a few hundred user-facing failures (attached logs). This directly impacted a scheduled product demo for a pilot customer.

We appreciate the incident report your team started, but we need a formal remediation/compensation proposal — credits to offset the usage spike, a short-term SLA uplift for our busiest routes, and a 30-day trial extension to re-run tests. Please advise next steps and who on your side we should work with for procurement/legal.

Thanks,
Tom
VP Engineering, Velocity.ai
[attachment: service_logs_snippet.txt (text)]

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Tom Hayes <tom@velocity.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-01T09:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Production errors during launch window — request for compensation and trial extension

Tom —

I'm really sorry about the disruption this morning. Thank you for sending the logs. We're on it — I've looped in Jordan (your AE) and Marissa (Sales lead) to coordinate credits and the commercial side, and Rishi from Ops will triage stack traces with our SREs.

Immediate plan:
- Rishi will confirm root-cause and estimated impacted token count by EOD PST.
- Jordan/Marissa will pull together a compensation proposal (credits + trial extension) to present to you by tomorrow.
- I'll fast-track an incident summary for your procurement/legal team.

Can you confirm whether you need funds applied as usage credits, or a formal one-time credit and a separate trial extension? Also confirm the billing contact (for the DocuSign addendum).

Hannah
Sr. Manager, Customer Success — Redwood Inference
[attachment: incident_summary_20270401.pdf (draft)]

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-01T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Production errors during launch window — request for compensation and trial extension

Team — quick notes from SRE review (prelim):
- Root cause: transient KV cache eviction during a burst that hit a particular model shard. This caused ~2–3x CPU on affected workers and a spike in 5xx for the 05:45–08:10 PT window.
- Estimated impacted tokens: 2.1M–2.6M (we'll finalize with request logs).
- Mitigation: rolling restart and a small config tweak to auto-prefetch hot prefixes. Deployed at 08:50 PT; error rate dropped to baseline.

Recommendation for commercial: apply a consumption credit equal to 100% of affected usage (to be conservative) + 30-day trial extension and a temporary raising of concurrency limits for the affected routes for 14 days to prevent regressions during further campaigns.

I'll attach the logs we pulled.

Rishi
SRE Lead — Redwood Inference
[attachment: service_logs_snippet.txt (text)]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Tom Hayes <tom@velocity.ai>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-02T08:15:00-07:00
Subject: Compensation proposal for Velocity.ai incident (draft)

Tom —

Thanks for your patience. Based on Rishi's estimate and our standard commercial playbook, here's a draft proposal for your review:

- Credits equal to 2.5M tokens usage at your current rate (~$18,750).
- 30-day trial extension from 2027-04-10 to 2027-05-10.
- One-time token top-up of 100k tokens to help re-run the demo suite.
- 14-day concurrency uplift (temporary config) and an SRE runbook call for knowledge transfer.

Next steps: if you agree in principle, we'll prepare a short credit addendum and a DocuSign for signature. Legal/procurement can be looped on the DocuSign.

Would you like the credit to be applied as a usage credit against your next invoice or as an account-level promotional credit?

Best,
Marissa
Enterprise Sales — Redwood Inference
[attachment: credit-addendum-draft.pdf (pdf)]

From: Priya Desai <priya.desai@velocity.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Tom Hayes <tom@velocity.ai>
Date: 2027-04-02T09:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Compensation proposal for Velocity.ai incident (draft)

Marissa —

Appreciate the thoroughness. Prefer the account-level promotional credit so it's immediately available for our test runs. Also happy to accept the 30-day extension and token top-up. Please send the DocuSign and we can have procurement sign by Friday.

Billing contact: Priya Desai <procurement@velocity.ai>

Thanks,
Priya
Head of Platform Engineering, Velocity.ai

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Mark Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-03T10:21:00-07:00
Subject: Approval request — Velocity.ai proposed remediation credits

Hi Markus —

Quick summary: Velocity.ai had a ~2.5M token impact from an April 1 outage during a pilot launch. Customer acceptance: account-level promotional credit + 30-day extension + 100k token top-up + temporary concurrency uplift. Estimated commercial cost ~$19k.

Requesting sign-off to route the addendum through DocuSign and apply the promotional credit to the account. This is within our SVP discretionary range but wanted your explicit ok before we execute.

Thanks,
Jordan
Account Executive — Redwood Inference

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-03T14:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Approval request — Velocity.ai proposed remediation credits

Jordan / team —

Approved. Please apply the account-level promotional credit of $19,000 equivalent, send the 30-day extension notice, and proceed with the 100k token top-up. Coordinate the DocuSign with legal; include the standard credit addendum language and a note requiring a brief SRE runbook session.

Markus
VP, Revenue Operations — Redwood Inference
